# Native tests for the Hubbub capture post-processor. Build (Windows):
#   cmake -S hubbub_test -B build -G Ninja && cmake --build build
# apm_probe links the downloaded libwebrtc prebuilt (third_party/libwebrtc).
cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.15)
project(hubbub_test CXX C)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 17)
get_filename_component(HUBBUB_RNNOISE_DIR "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/../third_party/rnnoise" ABSOLUTE)
add_subdirectory("${HUBBUB_RNNOISE_DIR}" rnnoise EXCLUDE_FROM_ALL)
if(NOT LIBWEBRTC_DIR)
  set(LIBWEBRTC_DIR "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/../third_party/libwebrtc")
endif()

if(EXISTS "${LIBWEBRTC_DIR}/lib/libwebrtc.dll.lib" OR EXISTS "${LIBWEBRTC_DIR}/lib/libwebrtc.so")
add_executable(apm_probe apm_probe.cc "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/../common/cpp/src/hubbub_audio.cc")
target_include_directories(apm_probe PRIVATE "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/../common/cpp/include")
target_link_libraries(apm_probe PRIVATE rnnoise)
target_compile_definitions(apm_probe PRIVATE $<$<BOOL:${WIN32}>:LIB_WEBRTC_API_DLL> RTC_DESKTOP_DEVICE $<$<BOOL:${MSVC}>:_USE_MATH_DEFINES>)
target_include_directories(apm_probe PRIVATE "${LIBWEBRTC_DIR}/include")
if(WIN32)
  target_link_libraries(apm_probe PRIVATE "${LIBWEBRTC_DIR}/lib/libwebrtc.dll.lib")
  add_custom_command(TARGET apm_probe POST_BUILD COMMAND ${CMAKE_COMMAND} -E copy_if_different
    "${LIBWEBRTC_DIR}/lib/libwebrtc.dll" $<TARGET_FILE_DIR:apm_probe>)
else()
  target_link_libraries(apm_probe PRIVATE "${LIBWEBRTC_DIR}/lib/libwebrtc.so" pthread)
  set_target_properties(apm_probe PROPERTIES BUILD_RPATH "${LIBWEBRTC_DIR}/lib")
endif()
endif()

# Pure DSP tests, no libwebrtc: frame buffering, resampler, gain/limiter,
# peak meter, RNNoise.
set(PLUGIN_COMMON "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/../common/cpp")
if(MSVC)
  add_compile_options(/W4 /WX /wd4100)
else()
  add_compile_options(-Wall -Wextra -Werror)
endif()
add_executable(hubbub_audio_test hubbub_audio_test.cc "${PLUGIN_COMMON}/src/hubbub_audio.cc")
target_include_directories(hubbub_audio_test PRIVATE "${PLUGIN_COMMON}/include")
target_link_libraries(hubbub_audio_test PRIVATE rnnoise)
if(NOT MSVC)
  target_link_libraries(hubbub_audio_test PRIVATE pthread)
endif()
if(MSVC)
  target_compile_definitions(hubbub_audio_test PRIVATE _USE_MATH_DEFINES)
endif()

# Diagnostic taps (WAV writer, ring buffer, injection).
add_executable(hubbub_tap_test hubbub_tap_test.cc "${PLUGIN_COMMON}/src/hubbub_audio.cc")
target_include_directories(hubbub_tap_test PRIVATE "${PLUGIN_COMMON}/include")
target_link_libraries(hubbub_tap_test PRIVATE rnnoise)
if(NOT MSVC)
  target_link_libraries(hubbub_tap_test PRIVATE pthread)
else()
  target_compile_definitions(hubbub_tap_test PRIVATE _USE_MATH_DEFINES)
endif()

# Adapter tests (layouts, threads, teardown). Needs only libwebrtc's headers.
if(EXISTS "${LIBWEBRTC_DIR}/include/rtc_audio_processing.h")
  add_executable(hubbub_processor_test hubbub_processor_test.cc "${PLUGIN_COMMON}/src/hubbub_audio.cc")
  target_include_directories(hubbub_processor_test PRIVATE "${PLUGIN_COMMON}/include" "${LIBWEBRTC_DIR}/include")
  target_link_libraries(hubbub_processor_test PRIVATE rnnoise)
  target_compile_definitions(hubbub_processor_test PRIVATE $<$<BOOL:${WIN32}>:LIB_WEBRTC_API_DLL> $<$<BOOL:${MSVC}>:_USE_MATH_DEFINES>)
  if(NOT MSVC)
    target_link_libraries(hubbub_processor_test PRIVATE pthread)
  endif()
  # Offline tool: the capture hook over a WAV (see hubbub_offline.cc).
  add_executable(hubbub_offline hubbub_offline.cc "${PLUGIN_COMMON}/src/hubbub_audio.cc")
  target_include_directories(hubbub_offline PRIVATE "${PLUGIN_COMMON}/include" "${LIBWEBRTC_DIR}/include")
  target_link_libraries(hubbub_offline PRIVATE rnnoise)
  target_compile_definitions(hubbub_offline PRIVATE $<$<BOOL:${WIN32}>:LIB_WEBRTC_API_DLL> $<$<BOOL:${MSVC}>:_USE_MATH_DEFINES>)
  if(NOT MSVC)
    target_link_libraries(hubbub_offline PRIVATE pthread)
  endif()
endif()

# Real task runner (Hubbub fix: tasks run without the queue mutex). Set
# -DTASK_RUNNER_SRC=<path to an older runner .cc> to run the test against it.
if(WIN32)
  set(TASK_RUNNER_DEFAULT "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/../windows/task_runner_windows.cc")
  set(TASK_RUNNER_PLATFORM_DIR "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/../windows")
else()
  set(TASK_RUNNER_DEFAULT "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/../linux/task_runner_linux.cc")
  set(TASK_RUNNER_PLATFORM_DIR "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/../linux")
endif()
if(NOT TASK_RUNNER_SRC)
  set(TASK_RUNNER_SRC "${TASK_RUNNER_DEFAULT}")
endif()
add_executable(task_runner_test task_runner_test.cc "${TASK_RUNNER_SRC}")
target_include_directories(task_runner_test PRIVATE "${PLUGIN_COMMON}/include" "${TASK_RUNNER_PLATFORM_DIR}")
if(NOT WIN32)
  find_package(PkgConfig REQUIRED)
  pkg_check_modules(GLIB REQUIRED glib-2.0)
  target_include_directories(task_runner_test PRIVATE ${GLIB_INCLUDE_DIRS})
  target_link_libraries(task_runner_test PRIVATE ${GLIB_LIBRARIES} pthread)
endif()
if(WIN32)
  target_compile_definitions(task_runner_test PRIVATE UNICODE _UNICODE)
endif()
